Start date: 1897-09-22  
Subtract 24 weeks = 168 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 173 days.  

1897 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
September has 30 days, so:  
From 1897-09-22 go back 22 days → 1897-08-31.  
Remaining 173 − 22 = 151 days.  

August has 31 days, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (non-leap), January 31.  
Back from Aug 31:  
August: 31 days → 1897-07-31 (31 days back)  
Remaining 151 − 31 = 120 days.  

July: 31 days → 1897-06-30 (31 days back)  
Remaining 120 − 31 = 89 days.  

June: 30 days → 1897-05-31 (30 days back)  
Remaining 89 − 30 = 59 days.  

May: 31 days → 1897-04-30 (31 days back)  
Remaining 59 − 31 = 28 days.  

April: 30 days → 1897-03-31 (30 days back)  
Remaining 28 − 30 = −2 days → means go back 2 days into March: 1897-03-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1897-03-29
